Breaking stigma through stories.


The Neuro Diaries amplifies the voices of those experiencing Mental Health Conditions, Neurodivergence and Mental Illness. Interviewees articulate their lived experience with the condition from symptoms to diagnosis journeys and their experience of stigma. Breaking down what it ACTUALLY is, stereotypes aside.


Listen to real experience journeys of those with Autism, ADHD, Bipolar, C-PTSD, Peri & Post natal Depression, Anxiety, Major Depressive Disorder, OCD, Schizophrenia, Borderline Personality Disorder, Substance Abuse and more. Interviews with Psychologists and thought leaders offering fresh perspectives in this space.


I believe in the power of our stories—power in sharing them, feeling seen, and being heard.
Sometimes, the simple act of sharing your story and being witnessed in a community can bring healing, understanding, and cultural change.
This belief is the foundation of The Neuro Diaries; a safe space for people to share their stories, build connections, and create an authentic community.
Here, we come together to learn from each other, gain strength, and inspire cultural change.
My mission is to make the world a safer and happier place for neurodivergent children and those struggling with mental health conditions and mental illness.

Welcome to the Visit Arundel Podcast, your backstage pass to one of the most characterful towns in West Sussex.

title: You Think This Is Real?
author: Camo Kimble
description:
You Think This Is Real?

The internet changed what success looks like.

The cars. The houses. The private jets. The followers. The exits. The perfect relationships. The overnight wins.

But how much of it is actually real?

You Think This Is Real? is a podcast hosted by Greg “Camo” Kimble that goes behind the image of success to uncover the stories people usually leave out.

Greg sits down with entrepreneurs, creators, leaders, and people who have lived behind the highlight reel to talk about what it actually took to get where they are—the money they lost, the things they rented, the businesses that nearly failed, the relationships put under pressure, the mistakes they buried, and the moments that never made it to social media.

Sometimes the image is fake.

Sometimes the success is real—but the story behind it looks nothing like the one you were sold.

And sometimes the most impressive thing about someone has nothing to do with what they own.

No highlight reel. No pedestal. No pretending.

Just honest conversations about success, failure, money, identity, and the increasingly blurry line between looking successful and actually living a successful life.

You’ve seen the image. Now hear the real story.

Episodes trace everything from Samhain, All Hallows’ Eve, and medieval traditions to ghosts, witches, monsters, jack-o’-lanterns, trick-or-treating, costumes, haunted attractions, horror entertainment, candy traditions, and the commercialization of Halloween. The show also explores regional customs, famous scares, folklore, urban legends, paranormal beliefs, historical controversies, and the ways Halloween has changed across different countries and generations.

Whether you love haunted houses, horror movies, folklore, costumes, or simply want to understand where Halloween traditions came from, the podcast tells the stories behind the holiday and the people, beliefs, and events that shaped it. The History of Halloween Podcast is hosted by Josh Linsk.

From William Barentsz spending the first polar winter in a house built of driftwood, to Fridtjof Nansen drifting for three years in the Fram, to Ernest Shackleton, Douglas Mawson, Roald Amundsen and Robert Falcon Scott, Polaris is the history of human beings at the limit of what a body can endure. description:
What happens when the system you knew stops working, and there’s no rollback?


The Cutover: Stories of When the Switch Flipped is a podcast about the defining moments that change the direction of our lives, careers, and businesses.


Hosted by Lawrence Spector, an engineering leader with 25 years of experience building and leading teams across industries including finance, defense, telecom, medical devices, gaming, cybersecurity, and AI, The Cutover takes an engineering concept and applies it to something much more personal.


In technology, a cutover is the moment a new system goes live. Months of preparation lead to one point of no return. Life has cutovers too, but unlike at work, there’s usually no rehearsal, rollback plan, or war room waiting when they happen.


Each week, Lawrence shares a story from his own journey or sits down with founders, engineers, leaders, and builders to examine one real moment when something changed. The decision they almost didn’t make. The diagnosis they didn’t expect. The failure that forced a new direction. The opportunity that opened one door while closing another.


These aren’t highlight reels. They’re stories about what someone believed before, what actually happened, what became clear afterward, and what they would do differently now.


Because sometimes the most important part of the story isn’t where you ended up.


It’s the moment the switch flipped.

title: The Castaways of Disappointment Island (A True Survival Tale)
author: Herbert Escott Inman
description:
When the Dundonald sank in the treacherous waters off Disappointment Island in 1907, apprentice sailor Charles Eyre faced a harrowing fight for survival. Stranded on a desolate isle 500 kilometers south of New Zealand, Eyre and his fellow castaways endured seven grueling months of isolation, battling not just the elements but the haunting uncertainty of rescue. In "Castaways of Disappointment Island," Herbert Escott Inman masterfully recounts this true story of resilience against all odds.

Listeners will journey alongside Eyre as he navigates the challenges of limited food, harsh weather, and dwindling hope. The struggle for survival brings to light profound themes of camaraderie, despair, and the indomitable human spirit. Eyre's vivid memories paint a stark picture of life on the brink—where each day could be their last, yet also a testament to their will to live.

As the castaways forage for sustenance and craft makeshift shelters, they confront both physical and psychological trials that test their resolve. Will help ever arrive, or is their fate sealed on this unforgiving island? Discover the gripping tale of hope and perseverance in "Castaways of Disappointment Island," where every moment counts and survival is never guaranteed.

This is a question we get all the time as therapists, and while there definitely isn’t a straight up answer, we think part of it comes from learning to recognize and work with the nuance that life brings instead of constantly fighting against it.

What Else Is True? is a podcast hosted by two therapists, who explore the nuance in the answers to life's important questions.

From the basics of how our nervous systems, emotions, and thoughts work, to the more complicated stuff like relationships, trauma, boundaries, and emotional regulation. We want to share what we know, what we think, and some of the things we use both professionally and personally to navigate the complicated mixed bag of experiences that comes with being human.

author: Marie Stuppard
description:
The Diaspora Podcast explores what it truly means to live between cultures, identities, and worlds.

Through powerful conversations and personal stories, this podcast highlights the experiences of immigrants, first-generation families, and members of the global diaspora as they navigate identity, culture shock, language, family traditions, and belonging.

From leaving home to building a life in a new country, each episode dives into the emotional, cultural, and personal journeys that shape the immigrant experience. We talk about the challenges of adapting to new environments, preserving cultural roots, raising children across cultures, and finding pride in where we come from.

Whether it’s stories of migration from Haiti, reflections on growing up between two cultures, or conversations about language, heritage, and community, Diaspora Podcast celebrates the resilience, complexity, and beauty of living between worlds.

If you’ve ever felt caught between cultures — or proud to carry multiple identities — this podcast is for you.

Subscribe and join the conversation as we explore stories from across the diaspora.

author: The Inspiration Of A CEO Podcast
description:
Success doesn't happen by chance. It is built through vision, discipline, courage, and an unwavering commitment to growth.
The Inspiration of a CEO is more than a podcast—it’s a journey into the minds, stories, and experiences of leaders who dared to dream bigger, overcome adversity, and build something meaningful.
As your host, I explore the triumphs, setbacks, lessons, and defining moments that shape exceptional entrepreneurs, executives, and visionaries. Each episode dives into business strategy, leadership, personal growth, resilience, and the real experiences behind success.

From algorithmic social media feeds and the exhaustion of hustle culture to the paradox of modern dating apps, this podcast breaks down the invisible algorithms of human behavior. description:
Success should expand your life, not exhaust it.


The Endura Podcast is for high-achieving, high-functioning women who have built impressive careers and are ready for a life that feels as good as it looks on paper. Host Kim Abrego is a doctor of physical therapy, a former consultant with 25 years of experience, a founder who built and sold a company, a professional bodybuilder, a wife, and a mom of two. Each episode is built around the three pillars of the Endura Method. Lift covers your physical foundation. Love covers the relationships that sustain you. Luxe covers joy, designed on purpose. Kim shares real stories, practical tools, and honest conversations to help you build strength, protect your energy, and create a life that lasts.


New episodes every week.

description: Cold War history comes to life in Cold War Files, a compelling podcast exploring espionage, military strategy, and life behind the Iron Curtain. Discover the spies, double agents, intelligence operations, secret networks, number stations, and covert missions that shaped global politics from Berlin and East Germany to Vietnam and the Fulda Gap. Featuring expert interviews, firsthand accounts, weapons history, and stories from MI6, BRIXMIS, NATO, and the Soviet bloc, each episode reveals the human drama behind the conflict. Subscribe and listen to Cold War Files for fascinating stories from the world’s most dangerous standoff.

title: Insights & Aspirations

Women carrying library books by mule up Kentucky creeks. A stranger in Canton, Ohio, who answered his neighbors' letters. Veterans driven out of Washington. Farmers bidding a nickel to save a neighbor. Harlem rent parties, the Tree Army, and a boxer who paid back his relief. Researched from archives and oral histories; voices other than the narrator's are dramatized re-creations. A Narratique Studios production.

title: Call It Whatever
author: Spencer Jenkins
description:
Spencer Jenkins is going through it.

Spencer’s old life blew up in spectacular fashion: addiction, crime, homelessness, and prison. Now, navigating recovery and reentry with a little hindsight, a whole lot of humility, and a microphone, Spencer is rebuilding—brick by absurd brick.

Call It Whatever lives somewhere between where we’ve been and wherever we’re going: work, relationships, identity, faith, family, friendship, intimacy, and all the ridiculous little disasters happening in the meantime. Some of it is serious. A surprising amount of it is funny.

None of it is going as planned.

And maybe that’s the point.

Let’s be real - social media moves too fast for traditional execution to keep up anymore. Between shifting algorithms and the constant demand for high-velocity content, just grinding harder isn't a strategy. 
Welcome to The AI Social Playbook, a hands-on tactical lab built for modern social media pros and marketing leaders who are ready to build something bigger. title: Anshul Circle — Remembering Anshul Barnwal Through the Voices of His Family & Friends
author: Deepika Barnwal
description:
Anshul Circle is a space to remember, celebrate, and carry forward the light that Anshul brought into the lives of everyone who knew him.
Anshul’s name means sunbeam. Those who knew him remember him that way—as someone who brought warmth, energy, joy, and light into the lives around him.
Though his life was far too short, his impact continues through the people he loved, the friendships he built, and the stories we continue to tell. This is not a podcast about loss. It is about friendship, love, laughter, remembering, and keeping Anshul present in our lives while carrying his light forward.

title: The midnight visiter

description:
At exactly midnight, a strange visitor appears at the door of a quiet home. There is no warning, no explanation, and no trace of where they came from. What begins as an unsettling encounter slowly turns into something far more mysterious.

Who is the midnight visitor? Why did they come? And what happens when the night refuses to end?

A chilling story about fear, mystery, and the things we sometimes wish we had never opened the door to.

Sometimes life blows up the version of you that existed before. We’re Tiffany and Nicole, two best friends talking honestly about betrayal trauma, relationships, faith, healing, personal growth, and what it really takes to move forward after someone you trusted changes everything.

title: The Scarlet Letter by Nathaniel Hawthorne.
author: Popular Culture and Religion.
description:
The Scarlet Letter by Nathaniel Hawthorne.  
The Scarlet Letter is a historical romance novel written by Nathaniel Hawthorne and first published on March 16, 1850, by Ticknor, Reed & Fields. Set in the mid-17th-century Puritan Massachusetts Bay Colony, the narrative follows Hester Prynne, a woman convicted of adultery who gives birth to an illegitimate child and is publicly shamed by being forced to wear a scarlet embroidered "A" on her clothing as a perpetual symbol of her transgression, while she refuses to disclose the identity of the child's father.  
The novel delves into profound examinations of sin, personal guilt, societal hypocrisy, and the tension between individual conscience and communal legalism within the rigid framework of Puritan theology, portraying the settlement's austere environment as one that amplifies internal moral conflicts rather than resolving them. Hawthorne, drawing from historical records of colonial punishments, critiques the era's unforgiving orthodoxy through characters who grapple with concealed shame and the psychological burdens of unconfessed wrongdoing, transforming the scarlet letter from a mere badge of infamy into a complex emblem of defiance, isolation, and eventual redemption.  
Upon release, The Scarlet Letter met with rapid commercial success, as its initial print run of 2,500 copies sold out promptly, providing Hawthorne financial relief after years of obscurity, though it provoked debate among contemporary reviewers for its unflinching depiction of moral transgression and perceived sensuality, with some religious critics decrying its insufficient emphasis on orthodox Christian morality. Regarded as Hawthorne's masterwork, the book endures as a foundational text in American literature, influencing discussions on identity, shame, and the limits of punitive justice through its enduring symbolic depth and narrative economy.

title: PROJECT E.D.E.N.
author: T.J. Nagamos
description: > PROJECT E.D.E.N. is a post-apocalyptic science-fiction horror audio drama about artificial intelligence, bodily autonomy, human suffering, and what it actually means to be human. This project does not use AI.

title: Spiritually Goldie: Daily Tarot
author: Spiritually Goldie
description: Welcome! I am a psychic-medium and certified yoga teacher, my sun sign is Libra, moon sign Leo and my rising is Scorpio. I love diving deep into channeled messages with divine guidance through tarot readings and giving advice and life coaching using spirituality and practicality for others.

title: Make It Make Sense
author: Nitin
description:
Why do we fall for the wrong people? Why do we overthink? Why do we keep repeating the same patterns?
Welcome to Make It Make Sense - a psychology podcast that helps you understand yourself and the people around you.
From relationships and dating to emotions, confidence, anxiety, habits, friendships, and everyday human behaviour, each episode breaks down complex psychology into simple, practical conversations backed by science.
You'll find something here that stays with you long after the episode ends because life makes more sense when people do.

title: Ground Stop with Austin and Josh: Where Aviation Meets Real Life
author: Austin George, Josh Stone
description:
Ground Stop isn’t a podcast for airplane nerds. Technical analysis? NOT welcome here.
Hosted by best friends and airline pilots Austin George and Josh Stone, Ground Stop covers the wild side of aviation, travel, celebrity culture, airline life, and whatever everyone’s talking about that week.
Joined by celebrities, athletes, entrepreneurs, and entertainers, they dive into the trips, chaos, stories, and life on the ground—with strong opinions, zero filter, and plenty of turbulence.
Ground Stop — where aviation meets real life.

title: Our Town Square Talks
author: Jackson County Times
description: News in and around Jackson County! From headlines, weekends, events and so much more! Stay tuned for the latest!

title: RAF Quick Clips
author: Chris Compton
description: Bite-sized financial insights and actionable stewardship strategies from Richland Ave Financial, delivered in quick, concise clips to help you make informed decisions.

title: The Doctor, the Vicar and the Headteacher
author: Andy, David and Jon
description:
Three friends and three very different working lives!
The Doctor, The Vicar and The Headteacher brings together a retired doctor, a vicar and a former headteacher for light-hearted conversations about life and the issues of the day.
Drawing on years spent in medicine, the church and education, Jon, David and Andy swap stories, opinions and experiences — sometimes agreeing, sometimes not — as the conversation wanders from the everyday to the serious and back again.

title: Finance, Strategy & Growth in Ireland
author: norickeastham
description:
The Renewable Energy Dealroom: Finance, Strategy & Growth in Ireland is an educational podcast exploring the commercial, financial, strategic, and transactional realities shaping Ireland’s renewable energy sector. Each episode examines how renewable energy projects move from early-stage ideas and feasibility assessments through financial modelling, development, investment, transactions, and long-term strategic growth.The series is designed for renewable energy developers, investors, property professionals, contractors, legal and financial professionals, business leaders, and anyone seeking a clearer understanding of how Ireland’s renewable energy market works from a commercial perspective.

Episodes will explore subjects such as onshore and offshore wind, solar energy, waste-to-energy, project evaluation, financial modelling, due diligence, bid management, project finance, M&A, market intelligence, strategic planning, and the practical challenges involved in bringing renewable energy projects forward.For professionals looking to explore the commercial side of Ireland’s renewable energy landscape, https://www.stakelumconsultancy.com/ provides a useful reference point for understanding how commercial advisory, corporate finance, transaction support, and strategic advisory can fit into the renewable energy project lifecycle.

The podcast will also translate complex industry concepts into accessible discussions, reflecting the educational approach of Stakelum Consultancy, which provides seminars, CPD courses, and Lunch & Learn sessions covering the Irish renewables market and its financial, legal, commercial, and technological dimensions.

title: The Doctor & The Diva; Real Talk About Beauty, Health, and Feeling Good in Your Own Skin
author: Vabally Media
description:
What happens when a South Beach socialite and her favorite doctor sit down to talk about the things women really want to know?
Welcome to The Doctor & The Diva, where Ally brings the real-life questions, opinions, experiences—and sometimes the questions women are thinking but may be too embarrassed to ask. Dr. V brings the medical perspective.
Together, they have honest, sometimes funny, and occasionally uncomfortable conversations about beauty, cosmetic treatments, health, aging, hormones, body image, confidence, relationships, and what it really means to feel good in your own skin.
From Botox and fillers to menopause, weight, skin, supplements, self-image, and the choices we make about our bodies, nothing is too awkward or off-limits.
You’ll get medical facts without the medical lecture, real-life perspective without the BS, different opinions, a little disagreement, and plenty of questions you may have been afraid to ask your doctor.
The Doctor explains. The Diva asks what everyone else is thinking.
Because looking good is one thing.
Feeling good in your own skin is another.
Connect with The Doctor & The Diva
For questions, collaborations, or future episode ideas:
Ally: allywingate3@gmail.com
Dr. Vaibhav: drvabpat@gmail.com

title: Respiratory Therapy Deep Dive
author: O2Jockey
description: Accelerate your study routine with Respiratory Therapy Deep Dive, the ultimate on-the-go audio guide built explicitly for busy RT students. These short, high-yield learning casts transform dense cardiopulmonary textbooks into punchy, easy-to-digest audio breakdowns. Perfect for your daily clinical commute, each focused episode unpacks critical concepts like complex mechanical ventilation settings, advanced pharmacology, and tricky arterial blood gas interpretations. You will love this podcast because it is designed to deliver concise, scenario-based insights.

title: Experience the Reformation with Lou Carbone
author: Lou Carbone
description: Experience the Reformation is built around a simple but powerful idea: it’s time to reform the way we think about experience. Hosted by the Godfather of Experience Management, Lou Carbone (Founder and CEO of Experience Engineering), the show explores the movement beyond simply measuring what customers say and toward understanding how experiences are perceived, processed, remembered, and felt. Through conversations with industry leaders and thinkers, the show explores the future of experience, behavioral science, emotional resonance, AI, and the relationship between people and organizations.

title: Ruin Represented
author: Garrett Abell, Sarabeth Matteson, Molly McHugh
description: A final group project podcast for the graduate elective, Exploring Critical Heritage, at SUNY Purchase. The episode highlights Cuban poet, Nancy Morejón, and a close reading of her poem, "Love, Attributed City," through the lens of ruin as defined by Georg Simmell. Garrett Abell, Sarabeth Matteson, and Molly McHugh discuss.

title: The Bachtalk Podcast
author: Carlton Monroe
description:
Bachtalk features posts, essays, and podcasts. These usually start with music, particularly the music of J. S. Bach, but can end up anywhere.

bachtalk.substack.com

title: Place Cards: an iThrive Collective Podcast with Terri Thorne
author: Author Terri Thorne, iThrive Collective Founder
description: Place Cards is a survivor‑led podcast for adults healing from childhood sexual abuse, including incest. Inspired by Terri Thorne’s book Set Your Own Table, it explores childhood trauma, toxic family patterns, boundaries, generational trauma, and cycles of family abuse. Through honest conversations and survivor insight, we look at how adult struggles connect to childhood sexual abuse and how to reclaim voice, choice, and power.

title: The OFFSCRIPT Podcast
author: Offscript
description:
The OFFSCRIPT Podcast is a space for honest thoughts, real conversations, and perspectives on the things that shape our lives.
TOP explores faith, purpose, personal growth, business, relationships, mindset, lifestyle, and the realities of figuring life out. Some episodes are reflective. Some are practical. Some are simply conversations that need to be had.
There’s no rigid script and no pressure to have everything figured out. Just genuine conversations, lessons from experience, different perspectives, and the occasional thought that makes you stop and think.

title: The Yellow Mic
author: Nayax
description:
The Yellow Mic is Nayax's podcast about the business behind cashless commerce. Each episode brings on the operators, partners, and people who make unattended retail work, for honest conversations about growing revenue, running smarter operations, and keeping customers coming back.
Nayax works in 120+ countries, but this show isn't about our technology. It's about the people using it, and the decisions behind a business with no cashier at the counter.
Whether you run a handful of machines or a fleet across borders, or are just curious how cashless commerce works - take a seat at the table.

title: True Affirmations
author: Lee Harlyn
description: A calming affirmations podcast inspired by The Secret and the Law of Attraction. Each 2-minute episode blends gratitude, self-love, and manifestation affirmations with soothing background sounds every Monday and Wednesday. On Tuesdays, a longer episode shares a true story of how these affirmations come to life. Listen to relax, realign, and attract everything meant for you.

title: Homebody Podcast
author: Gihan
description:
Where we discuss what it takes to create a life that aligns with each and every stages of womanhood, bringing delusions into life & making it financially and emotionally fulfilling. 
Expect this conversation to stem from a village, I'll be inviting guest teachers and opening up the channel for brave and vunerable conversations that we never had access to before. 
Stick around, I am taking you up for a wild ride, but most importantly, stay emotionally supported in each episode! 
Lots of love to you!

title: Excessive Baggage with Bill + Lyndsay
author: Bill and Lyndsay Handel
description:
Two hosts, twenty-six years apart. She plans every trip down to the last detail. He forgets something in every country. They both get on the plane.

This is Excessive Baggage with Bill and Lyndsay Handel. It's about what it takes to see the world in a body that doesn’t cooperate — the oceans, the planes and trains, her wheelchair, which she lovingly calls her buggy — the long way around when there isn’t a ramp.

It's about where they went, where they're going, what went sideways, what he left at the gate, and why they’d do it again. Her pain doesn’t publish a schedule. His dedication doesn’t waver.

Nobody’s promised next year. So they go now because it all looks better through each other’s eyes.

Priority boarding only.

title: MHBC Sunday Sermons
author: Maxwell Hill Baptist Church
description: Stream the weekly Sunday sermons from Maxwell Hill Baptist Church in Beckley, WV.

title: Dollar Llama
author: Dollar Llama
description:
Plain-spoken thinking about money from someone who has spent his career inside family offices, the firms that manage money for wealthy families. Most people will never need a family office, but everyone can think like one. Each episode is an article from dollar-llama.com, read aloud: investing, real estate and planning, without the sales pitch. No ads, no affiliate links, nothing for sale.
Narrated with an AI version of the author's voice. Views are my own and not those of my employer. Nothing here is investment advice.

title: What's Your Story with Joshua Oppenheim
author: Joshua Oppenheim
description: Conductor Joshua Oppenheim sits down with composers, performers, and creative minds for real conversations about the lives behind the music — where they came from, what shaped them, and the stories they carry into every performance.

title: The Three Zzzed's to Better Sleep
author: Dave Algeo
description: A short free audio course to help you improve your sleep routines, build your day around better sleep and feel like you have a little more energy during the day.

title: Mansfield Park by Jane Austen | Audiobook
author: Jane Austen
description: „Mansfield Park” by Jane Austen is a novel filled with subtle emotions, intrigue, and social tensions. Fanny Price, raised in a poor family, is taken in by her wealthy relatives at Mansfield Park. There, she becomes both a witness and participant in the complicated relationships among the family members and their guests – mysterious figures who soon disrupt the harmony of the household. The protagonist, full of inner strength, must navigate societal expectations, loyalty to her family, and the surprising emotions that shake her orderly world. „Mansfield Park” is a tale of love, honor, and the choices that shape the fates of its characters.

title: Chris P, Cinema Sherpa
author: Chris P, Cinema Sherpa
description:
Classic films, questionable opinions, and absolutely no film-critic qualifications!
I’m Chris P, the Cinema Sherpa — guiding you through classic movies, from the obscure and forgotten to the famous and fabulous. No snobbery, no film-school lectures… just me, having fun talking about the films I love.
Grab a cuppa or a beer...I don't care, settle in, and let’s get stuck into some classic cinema.
Got a film suggestion or just fancy saying hello? Email me at: chrispsherpa@gmail.com
